page.layout: One scan showing the outside of a bound book: a plain vellum or leather binding cover with corner and spine ties, no printed text. Nothing to transcribe in any column or margin.
page.notes: The scan shows a blank book cover (binding), not a printed page. No text, page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. Stains, discolouration and the ties of the binding are not printed matter and are left out. The dark background is the scanning surface and is not part of the page.
